'''Flinn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a young recruit in the [[Imperial Naval Academy (Coruscant)|Coruscant Naval Academy]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's rise for power]]. After attending the academy, he, along with fellow cadet [[Kestrel (individual)|Kestrel]], were selected to monitor a new [[Force-sensitive/Legends|talented]] recruit named [[Lune Oddo Divinian]]. In a flight simulator, Flinn and Kestrel fought against Lune and [[Trever Flume]] until they were easily defeated.
